title: SDD Archive Manifest (archive.yml)
description: Phase M0 skeleton — archive.yml schema per blueprint §7 archive/. Phase M5 archive ceremony 启用. 完整 retention_class + ai_visibility + superseded_by 规则在 Phase M2 / M5 内容填充.

superseded_by.description: 替代位置 (paths to active source)

original_state.description: 归档前的 state 字段

last_active_version.description: 归档前最后一个 active 版本号 (e.g. v2.2)

ai_visibility.description: hidden = AI 不应读取 (默认；适用 superseded STANDARD); reference = AI 可查阅历史背景 (适用 deprecated ADR)

retention_class.description: 保留期 (permanent: 不可删；5-year: 5 年后 purge-eligible；1-year: 1 年后 purge-eligible)

related_decisions.description: 驱动本次归档的 ADR 列表

_TBD_M5_: archive.yml 字段与 archive/<type>/ 目录结构的硬绑定 (rule/ vs decisions/superseded/ vs capabilities/<dom>/<cap>/<date>/)
TOMBSTONE.md 与 archive.yml 字段映射 (TOMBSTONE 顶部红 NOTE)
G14/G15 archived reference 扫描的 allowlist 字段 (如 active CHANGELOG 引用 archived ADR 是合法的)
